comment: muse.c use_misc() MUSE_POT_INVISIBILITY with a cursed potion calls you_aggravate(). The hostile gnome lord picks up the dropped potion while the hero walks east, and drinks it once the hero is out of reach. After cls() and You_feel(), display_nhwindow(WIN_MAP, TRUE) waits at --More-- over a map that shows only the gnome lord and the hero; the next key lets docrt() restore the map.
